title: From stopping drugs to carrying heroin? Punjab cop held with 15 kg drugs worth Rs 40 cr - Moneycontrol.com
full_text:
A Punjab Police constable deployed to prevent drone-based drug smuggling along the International Border has been arrested with 15 kg of heroin valued at more than Rs 40 crore in Tarn Taran district, NDTV reported.
The accused constable, identified as Karandeep Singh, was arrested during a joint operation conducted by the Border Security Force (BSF) and investigative agencies in the Sarai Amanat Khan area of the border district.
According to officials, Singh was allegedly carrying the heroin consignment from the border area to his native village Bhusse when he was intercepted, NDTV reported.
Investigating agencies are now probing the source of the seized heroin, the intended recipient of the consignment and the possible network involved in the alleged trafficking operation.
